question: Who was the head coach of the team that won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Dravid**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 

• **Rahul Dravid**, known as "The Wall" of Indian cricket, is one of the most respected figures in the cricketing world. 

• He became the **head coach of the Indian men's cricket team** in November 2021, succeeding Ravi Shastri. 

• Under his coaching, India has focused on nurturing young talent and building a strong bench strength across all formats. 

• Rahul Dravid has previously worked as the **head coach of the India Under-19 and India A teams**, where he played a pivotal role in grooming future stars such as Shubman Gill, Rishabh Pant, and Prithvi Shaw. 

• India's performance in international tournaments under Rahul Dravid's coaching has been closely monitored, with a focus on achieving consistency and strategic gameplay.
